subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main reproduction of the secondary-agent heartbeat failure under session.scope "global" plus dmScope "per-channel-peer" before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection supports the reporter's new hypothesis, but the affected global-session behavior is compatibility-sensitive and the issue is already labeled for maintainer review and live repro.

options.title: Run live repro first

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
